name: Hitozuma no Himitsu Aya no Jouji
original_name: 人妻の秘蜜 アヤの情事
source:
Aya is beloved and kind wife. Main character finds a link to the AV video with a woman looking exactly like Aya. But it can't be his deaf wife. Still, an investigation is needed.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
彩是深爱丈夫、温柔体贴的妻子。主人公发现一则成人视频链接，片中女子与彩一模一样。但那不可能是自己失聪的妻子。尽管如此，仍有必要调查。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
